An internal survey does not change the readiness dashboard; a consultant's survey shows on it as a separate series.

list.title: Committees
list.intro: The facility's committees, how often each must meet, and the minutes of every meeting. Approved minutes count as evidence on the elements a committee oversees.

list.newIntro: Name the committee, say how often it must meet, and who chairs it. You add the elements it oversees on its page.

form.nameHint: Enter at least one of the two names.

detail.elementsHint: Minutes filed from now on are linked to these elements. Minutes already filed keep the elements they were linked to.
detail.noElements: This committee oversees no elements yet.
detail.archiveHint: The committee leaves the list. Its meetings and minutes stay on record.

minutes.title: File minutes
minutes.hint: {count, plural, =0 {The minutes are filed as a document for approval. Link the committee to elements first if they should count as evidence.} one {The minutes are filed as a document for approval, linked to the # element this committee oversees.} other {The minutes are filed as a document for approval, linked to the # elements this committee oversees.}}
minutes.fileHint: PDF, Word, Excel, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB. Minutes should name roles and decisions, never patients.
